steps.comment: Firstfield Meadow's last station and the graduation: Norbert in the gap in the fence (with Corvin, who would like a rival), a battle against the generated enemy, the knocked-down sprite from the generated damage sheet, the gap opening, the lore loop taken once, and the walk out. Stations one to three are set up by switch; firstfield walks them.

steps.label: below the gap in the fence
Norbert is standing in the gap, so the lawn is shut

steps.comment: Eight windows and Fizz's balloon before the battle. {advance} overruns into Scene_Battle and picks actor commands, which is harmless: the enemy is killed by hand below.

steps.label: STAND AND DELIVER starts a battle
against the generated enemy, drawn from his own battler image
sized to the party at the start of the fight: 90 x level 6 x three of them
station four done, and all four stations
and he is lying in the grass, drawn from the generated damage sheet
Norbert talks about Maud, lying down
the gap is open, and the lawn is up the path

steps.eval: window._q = 0; const o = Game_Interpreter.prototype.setupChoices; Game_Interpreter.prototype.setupChoices = function (p) { if (p[0][3] === 'No questions') { p = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p)); p[2] = ++window._q === 1 ? 0 : 3; } return o.call(this, p); }

steps.label: graduated, with a certificate, after asking about the Dark Lord's weakness once and hearing LORE
Norbert and the graduation are a trope each
and Fizz goes back to practising on the sheep
which is a short conversation that ends
the way out puts you back on the spur beside the rainbow
